 11 Beauty Stores To Find Viral Makeup, Skincare & Fragrances Online Ft. Beaubit, Sociolla and More
 Beauty
 Hair
 Skincare
 Shopping
 Cosmetics
 Perfume
 By 
 Cheryl
 on 20 Nov 2026 
 Beauty Editor
 Think Sephora, Watsons and Guardian are your only options for beauty shopping in Singapore? There are plenty of amazing platforms carrying viral Asian makeup, cult skincare and fragrances you may not have spotted elsewhere.  
 Consider this your browser-tab tour of beauty platforms in Singapore. From BEAUBIT’s emerging regional labels to Sociolla’s newly opened beauty playground, here are 11 online beauty stores worth exploring.  
 1. BEAUBIT  
 BEAUBIT feels like the beauty shelf of that friend who always knows the cool brands before everyone else. BEAUBIT spotlights emerging labels from across Asia, including Filipino favourite Sunnies Face, Indonesian brand Rosé All Day and viral Korean names such as Heveblue and glow.  
 The smaller catalogue makes browsing feel more like discovering recommendations from a beauty-loving friend. Orders are delivered locally, with self-collection available at Midview City.  
 Editor’s pick: glow Diamond Tinted Lip Oil , $58. Diamond powder and hydrating ingredients give lips buildable colour with a glossy, glass-like finish.   
 Explore BEAUBIT here . 
 2. Sociolla 
 Already a familiar beauty destination in Indonesia, Sociolla has arrived in Singapore with an extensive mix of makeup, skincare, haircare and body care. 
 Its range covers popular Asian brands alongside international names, making it easy to compare products without jumping between multiple websites. Those who prefer to shop in person can look forward to its physical stores at Funan and Bugis Junction too. 
 Editor’s pick: SKINTIFIC Cover All Perfect Cushion, $32.90 at regular retail price . The lightweight cushion is designed to resist oil, water and dullness for up to 12 hours, which sounds promising for Singapore’s humid weather. 
 Explore Sociolla here . 
 3. Beureka  
 Beureka brings a little deal-hunting energy to premium beauty, with skincare, cosmetics and fragrances from brands such as SK-II, Estée Lauder, La Mer and Clarins.  
 The livestream format also lets shoppers see the products more closely and ask questions before checking out. It is a more interactive way to browse, particularly when you are comparing fragrance options or waiting for a good deal. 
 Editor’s pick: Maison Margiela REPLICA Eau de Toilette 100ml, $219.90 . The listing includes popular scents such as Lazy Sunday Morning and By The Fireplace. 
 Explore Beureka here .  
 4. COCOMO 
 Long-time K-beauty shoppers may already recognise COCOMO. The Singapore-based store regularly updates its catalogue with Korean makeup, skincare and haircare from brands such as TFIT, COSRX and Medicube. 
 Products are stocked locally, so you will not have to wait for international shipping whenever a viral Korean product catches your attention. The range also makes it easy to browse by beauty concern or product type. 
 Editor’s pick: TFIT Cover Up Pro Concealer, $16.45 . Each palette contains three blendable shades that can be mixed and matched across redness, blemishes and dark circles. 
 Explore COCOMO here . 
 5. Hush Cosmetics 
 Hush Cosmetics focuses mainly on Korean beauty, with locally stocked products from brands such as Medicube, Anua, Round Lab and Beauty of Joseon. 
 The site is easy to browse when you already have a skincare concern in mind, whether that is acne, enlarged pores or dehydration. Self-collection is also available for shoppers who need their products quickly. 
 Editor’s pick: Medicube Zero Pore Pad, $19 . These toner pads are made for gently exfoliating the skin and caring for visible pores without adding another complicated step to your routine. 
 Explore Hush Cosmetics here . 
 6. Beauty & Bath 
 Beauty & Bath is a useful name to know if you have been curious about Thai beauty products. The local retailer carries brands such as Cathy Doll and Baby Bright, including colourful makeup and character collaborations that can be harder to find elsewhere. 
 There is also a physical store at Lucky Plaza, where you can browse the products in person instead of relying entirely on online swatches. 
 Editor’s pick: Cathy Doll x Maeng Curvy Metal Mascara, $12 . Its slim curved metal wand is designed to reach the roots and corners of the lashes while keeping them neatly separated. 
 Explore Beauty & Bath here . 
 7. Eclare 
 Eclare offers makeup, skincare and fragrances across a mix of established and emerging brands. The fragrance selection is especially worth a browse if you enjoy comparing designer scents or checking what has recently arrived. 
 Instead of limiting your search to the usual beauty chains, the platform gives you another place to look for new additions and selected fragrance sizes. 
 Editor’s pick: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum, from $155 . Dark berries, jasmine, vanilla and amber come together in a creamy gourmand scent for anyone who enjoys sweet, fruity fragrances. 
 Explore Eclare here . 
 8. April Boulevard 
 April Boulevard stocks a mix of Japanese beauty, skincare and lifestyle finds, including practical products that may not receive as much attention on social media. 
 It is a useful platform for discovering Japanese sunscreens, body care and everyday essentials beyond the brands already found at most local drugstores. 
 Editor’s pick: Ajuste Non-Fragrance UV Spray SPF50+ PA++++, from $12.90 . The lightweight spray can be used on the face, body and hair, making sunscreen touch-ups easier when you are out. 
 Explore April Boulevard here . 
 9. VIIMART 
 VIIMART carries a broad range of Korean skincare, makeup and haircare from familiar brands such as Laneige, Sulwhasoo and Innisfree. 
 Its sale sections are worth checking when you want to restock a product you already use or try a recognisable K-beauty formula at a lower price. There are also plenty of options under $50 for smaller gifts and everyday purchases. 
 Editor’s pick: Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask, $26 . The cult lip mask makes an easy introduction to the brand and is especially handy for lips that often feel dry from air-conditioning. 
 Explore VIIMART here . 
 10. Ksisters 
 Ksisters is one of Singapore’s better-known destinations for Korean beauty, with a carefully curated range of skincare, makeup, supplements and lifestyle products. 
 The platform often introduces trending Korean brands to local shoppers and explains how to work them into a routine. You can also visit its flagship store at Wheelock Place to browse the products in person. 
 Editor’s pick: Dr. Althea 345 Relief Cream, from $13.40 . The lightweight moisturiser has gained attention for soothing and hydrating sensitive or blemish-prone skin without feeling overly heavy. 
 Explore Ksisters here . 
 11. Novela 
 Novela brings makeup, skincare and fragrances from premium brands together at lower member prices. Its range covers everything from Korean skincare to designer perfumes, making it a convenient stop when your shopping list spans several beauty categories. 
 The home-grown retailer now has eight outlets across Singapore, including newer locations at CityLink Mall and Changi City Point. Those who shop regularly can consider its VIP plans for access to member prices and additional perks. 
 Editor’s pick: Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless Setting Spray, $57. The popular formula helps makeup last longer while leaving the skin looking fresh, making it useful for long workdays, dinners and events in Singapore’s humidity. 
 Explore Novela here .
